say:4:1320339001:1.text: This painting is Levski's final piece, which he titled "Unfinished". We've restored it, and I believe it would be meaningful for you to keep it as a cherished memory of your son.
say:4:1320339001:1.source_cn: 大叔……这幅画是列夫斯基最后的作品，名叫《未完成》。我...

say:5:1320339002:1.text: I really appreciate it... but I... I can't accept this!
say:5:1320339002:1.source_cn: 这……这怎么能行呢！你们花钱买下它，怎么能送给我？！

say:6:1320339003:1.text: You bought it, and it feels wrong to take it...

choice_prompt:7:1320339003.text: You bought it, and it feels wrong to take it...

say:8:1320339005:1.source_cn: 列夫斯基……唉，我可怜的儿子……呜……

say:10:1320339006:3.text: Evgeny! Open up before I kick it down!

say:11:1320339007:1.text: I'll count to ten! One! Two! Three—
say:11:1320339007:1.source_cn: 我数到十，不开门的话我就踹了——！

say:12:1320339008:1.text: Ugh, how annoying! Can't they see this isn't a good time?
say:12:1320339008:1.source_cn: 门外是谁啊？好讨厌，都这种时候了还过来找茬！

say:13:1320339009:1.text: Magister, let's go check who's out there. It would be bad if they just barged in.
say:13:1320339009:1.source_cn: 梅林，我们出去看看吧。要是他们真的踹门闯进来就不好了。
say:13:1320339009:1.male: Magister, let's go check who's out there. It would be bad if they just barged in.
say:13:1320339009:1.female: Magister, let's go check who's out there. It would be bad if they just barged in.

choice:7:0:1.text: Levski wanted you to have it.
choice:7:0:1.source_cn: 这是列夫斯基的临终心愿
choice:7:0:1.male: Levski wanted you to have it.
choice:7:0:1.female: Levski wanted you to have it.

say:16:1320339004:0.text: Leaving this painting to you was Levski's last wish, and we genuinely want you to have it as well.
say:16:1320339004:0.source_cn: 是啊！将这幅画留给你是列夫斯基的心愿，我们也早就决定要...

choice:7:1:2.text: Please take it to remember him by.
choice:7:1:2.source_cn: 你要是想感谢我们，就收下！
choice:7:1:2.male: Please take it to remember him by.
choice:7:1:2.female: Please take it to remember him by.
